title: Rigorloom distribution-module declaration (modules/<name>/module.yaml)
description: Normative shape for a distribution module's module.yaml. Distribution modules (packaging/capability units, this schema) are distinct from the v0.12 stage contracts in modules/report/references/modules.yaml (pipeline stage composition). Validated structurally by pipeline/scripts/module_registry.py; declarations are pure literals — no expressions, includes, or interpolation.

name.description: Kebab-case module name; MUST equal the modules/<name>/ directory name.

rigorloom.description: Version range checked against [project].version in pyproject.toml; comma-separated comparators AND together (e.g. ">=0.16, <1.0"). Unsatisfied = load refusal.

script.description: Module-relative path to a checker script honouring the checker_base.py contract (JSON verdict on stdout, exit 0/2/3).
Module-relative path to the script dispatched for this subcommand.

pack_types.description: Personalization pack types this module defines; seeds the pack-type registry.

state_policy.description: stateless_final_pointer = stateless with a mandatory canonical/FINAL pointer at delivery (validated by the registry-declared check_canonical checker; module payload since v0.16 W3-S2b).

gates.description: Either an explicit list of checker/gate names the mode enforces, or a single gate-source reference: the literal 'declared' (per-workspace declared gates via declared_gates.py) or a stage-graph filename (e.g. 'stages.yaml') whose gate table defines the mode's gates.

kind.description: Declared-gate kind name this module registers (joins declared_gates.py's kind vocabulary; unique across enabled modules; must not shadow a core-implemented kind).

checker.description: Name of a checker (provided via provides.checkers by an enabled module) whose in-process check(workspace, **declared_params) implements the kind. A gate_kind naming a checker no enabled module provides is a loud enablement error.

gate_kinds.description: Declared-gate kind mechanisms (declared_gates.py delegation). A workspace gates.yaml declaring a kind with no enabled provider is a loud config refusal (exit 2), never a silent pass. Core-implemented kinds (json_equals/json_lt/json_gt/file_exists/text_absent, residue, density) stay core.

entry.description: Module-relative path to the panel entry file.

fragment.description: Module-relative path to the SKILL fragment merged by the installer.

script.description: Module-relative path to a preflight-contribution script honouring the checker_base.py contract (JSON verdict on stdout, exit 0/2/3), invoked as `python <script> <workspace>`.

preflight.description: Submission-preflight contributions: core's submission_preflight subprocess-composes each enabled contribution's JSON findings source-tagged into its own verdict. No modules enabled = those checks simply absent (absence is not failure).
